item.title: Assurant acquires Protection Point Service Plans
item.description: Assurant has acquired Protection Point Service Plans, a British Columbia-based provider and administrator of commercial equipment protection programs. Protection Point specializes in extended service plans and related protection for equipment used in agriculture, construction, material handling and forestry. The acquisition builds on an existing relationship: Protection Point already worked exclusively with Assurant’s Canadian commercial equipment business, with Assurant underwriting its programs.

item.title: Berkshire Hathaway underwriting earnings fall 43% in Q3 as Tokio Marine deal supports P&C reinsurance premiums
item.description: Berkshire Hathaway reported a 43% decline in net underwriting earnings across its insurance and reinsurance operations to $1.352 billion for the third quarter of 2026, while earnings for the first nine months fell 16% to $4.8 billion. The Berkshire Hathaway Reinsurance Group delivered pre-tax underwriting earnings of $582 million for Q3’26 and $1.868 billion for 9M’26, compared to $884 million in Q3’25 and $1.227 billion in 9M’25. As in the second quarter, P&C reinsurance top-line was boosted in the third quarter and first nine months of 2026 from the deal with Tokio Marine, under which NICO assumes on a quota share basis a portion of the non-life premiums written and related losses and expenses of the Japanese insurer on risks attaching over a 10-year term.

item.title: Automation Anywhere to acquire Boost.ai
item.description: Automation Anywhere has agreed to acquire conversational AI company Boost.ai from Nordic Capital, adding customer-facing chat and voice capabilities to its business automation platform. “By joining Automation Anywhere, we can connect the conversation, including voice, directly to the systems and people who get the work done, so a customer’s request is handled from start to finish.” – Jerry Haywood, CEO of Boost.ai. Automation Anywhere plans to connect those conversations to the systems and workflows needed to complete customer requests.

item.title: Trucordia expands BYU sponsorship
item.description: Trucordia has expanded its corporate sponsorship of Brigham Young University Athletics under a multiyear agreement that adds the insurance brokerage’s logo to BYU football helmet bumpers. “We’re proud to deepen our sponsorship with BYU Athletics.” – Felix Morgan, Trucordia’s CEO and chairman. Headquartered in Lindon, Utah, Trucordia has sponsored BYU Athletics since 2024.

item.description: Progressive has expanded its sponsorship with Joe Gibbs Racing, becoming the primary sponsor of Denny Hamlin’s No. Beyond race sponsorship, Progressive has featured Hamlin in commercials, agent events and community activities. “As we head into our third year together, Denny doesn’t just represent Progressive on race day, he’s part of the Progressive family.” – Mari Pumarejo, Progressive’s chief marketing officer.

item.title: AmeriLife Selects Palantir for Enterprise AI Transformation
item.description: (Image source: IIR.) AmeriLife (Clearwater, Fla.) has selected Palantir Technologies (Aventura, Fla.) for an enterprise-wide AI and data initiative spanning its Health and Wealth distribution organizations. The agreement brings Palantir Foundry and Artificial Intelligence Platform, or AIP, into AmeriLife’s operations with the goal of creating a common data foundation and supporting AI-driven workflows across distribution, case management and back-office functions. “Partnering with Palantir, which is widely trusted with some of the most complex and consequential data challenges in the world, allows us to rebuild how our business runs, from the first client conversation to the placed policy.” AmeriLife says the initiative is intended to go beyond adding AI tools to existing processes by building workflows on a unified data foundation.

item.title: ACORD’s Kellington Sees AI Opening for Industry Rethink
item.description: (Image source: IIR.) John Kellington sees the industry’s embrace of AI as an opportunity to reconsider how insurance operates—and what technology and standards must provide to support it. A Shared Vision for Change Kellington sees ACORD’s role as bringing together organizations that would struggle to establish common approaches independently. “If there’s something that I can do to help this industry get better because of my background experience,” Kellington says, “gosh, you know, that’s something everybody dreams about.” ACORD Names John Kellington CEO ACORD Adds Two Board Members

item.title: Amdocs Bets on EIS to Advance Agentic Transformation in Insurance
item.description: The telecommunications technology provider intends to combine EIS’ platform and insurance expertise with its own engineering, transformation and operational capabilities to build an insurance business centered on agentic technology and accountability for delivery. “They buy them because they believe the business case and execution plan will succeed.” Bringing aOS Into the Core A central element of Amdocs’ strategy is extending aOS, its agentic operating system developed for telecommunications, into insurance. (Image source: EIS powered by Amdocs homepage.) Amdocs’ acquisition of EIS gives the insurance core systems vendor more than a larger balance sheet.

item.title: California Homes Face Shutoffs as Santa Anas Raise Fire Risks
item.description: Thousands of homes and businesses north of Los Angeles face the risk of potential power cuts over the next two days as weak to moderate Santa Ana winds bring dangerous fire weather conditions. Southern California Edison is considering shutting off power to 4,639 homes and businesses in Los Angeles County, as well as another 297 in Ventura County, the utility said on its website. California has entered the most perilous stretch of its year-round fire season, when hot, arid winds roll down from the mountains and out to sea.

item.title: Berkshire’s Pivot to AI Bets Gets an Immediate Reality Check
item.description: After all, Buffett’s 2016 investment in Apple Inc., derided at the time as being late in the iPhone maker’s history, turned out to be one of Berkshire’s most lucrative bets. In his first year as Chief Executive Officer of Berkshire Hathaway Inc., Greg Abel has pushed the conglomerate into an entirely new area of investment: artificial intelligence. But with cracks in the AI trade starting to show, Berkshire’s sudden push may appear ill-timed.

item.title: Paris, Madrid Top Cities for Harsh Driving Events While Berlin Ranks Lowest: Study
item.description: The four cities with the highest efficiency scores, Berlin, Amsterdam, Dublin and Rome, are the four with the fewest harsh events per trip, while Paris, London and Madrid, the three lowest-scoring cities, have the three highest rates. Harsh acceleration accounts for 79% of Paris events and 69% of Madrid events, while Berlin and London split more evenly between acceleration and braking. Madrid (1,088) and Paris (1,191) sit far above the rest, at roughly one harsh event for every trip, with the gap between Berlin and Paris being 5.3 times, and between Berlin and Madrid 4.8 times.

item.title: Vantage Partnership Capital (AdVantage) drives $15m income for Howard Hughes in Q3 2026
item.description: Vantage Risk’s third-party reinsurance capital and investments platform has again delivered higher fee income to the benefit of its now owner, Bill Ackman linked Howard Hughes Holdings, with $13 million of fee income generated by its insurance-linked securities style partnerships with investors in Q3 2026 and $15 million of total net income from the ILS activities. Howard Hughes Holding stated that Q3 2026 fee income for AdVantage was, “resulting from the continued positive outcomes for recent property catastrophe business written in this structure.” Marc Grandisson, the former Arch Capital CEO who joined the Howard Hughes Holdings Board of Directors this year, commented during an earnings call today, “Net fee income was $13 million in the quarter, up from $9 million, and is $47 million year to date, versus the loss last year. It takes year-to-date fee income earned by the Vantage Partnership Capital team, operating its business through the AdVantage platform of companies, to $47 million.

item.title: Mandarin Re to establish retakaful window to deliver risk capacity to underserved markets
item.description: Mandarin Re, an international short-tail-lines reinsurer, has received regulatory approval from the Labuan Financial Services Authority to establish a retakaful window, paving the way for the company to offer Shariah-compliant reinsurance solutions globally. The newly established retakaful window operates as a dedicated Islamic division within the conventional reinsurer, allowing Mandarin Re to deliver treaties and programmes structured to support wakalah, mudharabah, and wakalah-waqf takaful providers. With the new licence, Mandarin Re is now able to help takaful operators world-wide to access additional capacity, allowing them to better serve their communities.

item.title: AM Best revises Premia Re Europe’s under review status to developing
item.description: AM Best has revised the implications of the under review status to developing from negative for the Financial Strength Rating of B++ (Good) and the Long-Term Issuer Credit Rating of “bbb” (Good) of Premia Reinsurance Europe S.A. The ratings agency explained that the revision of the under review status to developing followed Premia’s acquisition of Premia Re Europe. AM Best said the ratings of Premia Re Europe are expected to remain under review with developing implications until it gains clarity regarding the new owner’s plans for the entity.

item.title: Aon establishes North American Healthcare unit led by Nick Gaudiosi
item.description: Aon, a global insurance and reinsurance broker and risk adviser, has launched a North America Healthcare vertical within its Risk Capital business, led by Nick Gaudiosi. Through our Risk Capital structure, Aon is uniquely positioned to help connect both providers and insurers with the right capital, in the right structure, at the right time.” Since 2025, Gaudiosi has served as Senior Managing Director and Healthcare Segment Leader for Reinsurance, supporting the continued development of Aon’s medical professional liability reinsurance practice and team, and will continue to guide that strategy in his new role. He joined Aon in 2023 and previously served as President and Chief Operating Officer of American Healthcare Providers Insurance Services, which he led through its acquisition by Curi.

item.title: AM Best Upgrades Credit Ratings of Illinois Casualty and Lebanon Valley
item.description: AM Best has upgraded the Financial Strength Rating (FSR) to A (Excellent) from A- (Excellent) and the Long-Term Issuer Credit Ratings (Long-Term ICRs) to “a” (Excellent) from “a-” (Excellent) of Illinois Casualty Company (ICC) and Lebanon Valley Insurance Company (LV). The outlook of the Credit Ratings (ratings) has been revised to stable from positive. The ratings reflect Mutual Capital Insurance Group’s balance sheet strength, which AM Best assesses as very strong, as well as its adequate operating performance, neutral business profile and appropriate enterprise risk management (ERM).

item.title: Some 40% of US Planned Data Center Capacity Is in States Wanting to Hit Pause
item.description: All told, about 40% of pending data center capacity in the US is planned to be built in states where newly elected governors have promised to stop or pause such construction, according to data from Cleanview, a market intelligence company. Newly elected governors in Ohio, Georgia, Michigan, New Mexico and Texas campaigned on a promise to stop — or at least pause — data center construction statewide, while those in New York and Oregon pledged to prolong pauses already in place. Democrats now control key branches of state government in some of the country’s data center hotbeds, including Virginia, Pennsylvania and Arizona, and are likely to pursue utility and permitting policies that stall construction, according to a new report from BloombergNEF.

item.description: Jane Kim claimed victory over fellow Democrat Ben Allen in the race for California insurance commissioner on Friday. Assuming that is the case, I desperately want her to succeed, because if she succeeds, the state succeeds – especially the families in need that we’ve been fighting for across the state.” Kim and Allen advanced to the primary in the race for insurance commissioner. “Californians have kept our end of that bargain, but insurance companies have broken their side of the promise by denying, delaying and underpaying valid claims and dropping coverage.” Following Kim’s victory declaration, Allen’s campaign released the following statement: “Earlier today, I called Jane Kim to congratulate her.

item.title: GEICO adds auto insurance estimates to ChatGPT
item.description: GEICO has introduced a ChatGPT app that allows users to get an estimate of their auto insurance premium through a conversation. According to the app listing, users can request a GEICO estimate, ask about insurance costs for a particular vehicle or explore pricing when switching insurers. Estimates are based on information provided by the user and are not final quotes.

item.title: Coverage Cat offers umbrella insurance estimates through ChatGPT
item.description: Coverage Cat has introduced a ChatGPT app that lets users compare preliminary umbrella insurance estimates, continue applications and access policy information. The app generates estimates using state, coverage limits, exposure counts and aggregate household information. Selecting an estimate or saving a payment method does not confirm coverage, and ChatGPT cannot approve the application.

item.title: Aon and Blackstone funds launch Cortina Lloyd’s syndicate
item.description: Aon and funds managed by Blackstone have announced Cortina syndicate 1956, a new Lloyd’s syndicate providing multiyear reinsurance capacity to Aon clients, with QBE serving as managing agent. Cortina received in-principle approval from Lloyd’s on October 16, 2026, and plans to begin underwriting January 1, 2027, subject to final approval. Clients will receive a dividend based on Cortina’s share of their reinsurance programs, passing along savings from the syndicate’s operating structure.

item.title: Allstate Q3 Net Income Drops About 45% on Higher Catastrophe Losses
item.description: Allstate’s Property-Liability saw Q3 catastrophe losses nearly tripled to about $1.7 billion compared with the same period a year ago. third-quarter 2026 net income applicable to common shareholders dropped nearly 45% with underwriting income down about 30% during the period. Net income was about $2 billion for Q3 versus about $3.7 billion for Q3 2025.

item.title: Quality Engineering as the Foundation of Intelligent Insurance Systems
item.description: AI is quickly being rolled out across the property/casualty insurance industry in various forms. Insurers are now actively embedding AI into underwriting, claims, customer service, fraud detection, software development and operational workflows. Large language models are summarizing claim files, generating code, assisting adjusters, drafting customer communications and helping underwriters analyze increasingly complex risks.

item.description: With such a huge market under a seeming monopoly, where can competition — and the innovation that follows it — come from? If you were in Silicon Valley in the late 1990s, today’s AI boom might feel familiar. In 1998 and 1999, internet traffic was roughly doubling every six to nine months.

item.title: SafePoint adds another $100m+ layer to its catastrophe bond with Nature Coast Re 2026-4
item.description: In a clear display of the attractive catastrophe bond market conditions sponsors are experiencing, SafePoint Insurance Company is back to add another $100 million or more layer of reinsurance protection to its recently priced indemnity deal, with a Nature Coast Re Ltd. As we’ve been reporting, SafePoint successfully priced and secured its largest catastrophe bond ever, with the $650 million Nature Coast Re Ltd. Onto the new cat bond deal that SafePoint is now sponsoring, which is really an extension to the just priced $650 million Nature Coast Re 2026-2 .

item.title: As investors look to expand in private fixed income, ILS is the better alternative: Convergence
item.description: At a time when institutional investors and large allocators are looking for diversification and to expand their allocations to private fixed income and other private market asset classes, insurance-linked securities can offer a better alternative, speakers at the recent Convergence conference explained. institutional investors, and what’s really interesting is 75% of them are now telling us that they plan to increase their private fixed income or private markets allocation over the next five years. We’re seeing nearly 50% of our respondents saying they expect to have 20% or more of their portfolio allocated to private fixed income over the next five years.

item.title: Embassy makes Bert Ji PM of Ambassador cat bond fund, as MacGillivray departs
item.description: Embassy Asset Management, a registered US investment adviser, has announced that former Nephila Capital employee Bert Ji has taken over as the lead Portfolio Manager for the Ambassador mutual fund strategy that allocates to catastrophe bonds and private insurance-linked securities (ILS), as Niall MacGillivray has departed. Bert Ji had joined Embassy Asset Management in February 2026, becoming one of the portfolio managers for the Ambassador Fund strategy and the insurance-linked securities portfolios managed by the firm. Ji had supported MacGillivray in the portfolio management of the cat bond focused fund strategy since joining Embassy earlier this year.

item.title: IA Capital Group secures backing from QBE for new fintech and insurtech investment fund
item.description: The fund has been established to pursue investment opportunities among more mature fintech and insurtech businesses at a time when some traditional venture capital investors and corporate investment programmes are scaling back their involvement in these markets. IA Capital Group stated that the fund will concentrate on businesses operating in fintech, insurtech and related industries, with a particular emphasis on companies that have reached Series B funding or later stages of development. IA Capital Group, a New York-based venture capital investment firm focused on financial technology and insurance technology, has confirmed the first close of its Inter-Atlantic Opportunity Fund I.

item.title: Optio names Jamie Jeffers to lead Asia-Pacific growth as MD of Optio Asia
item.description: Optio Group, an independent specialty managing general agent (MGA), has named Jamie Jeffers as managing director of Optio Asia, tasking him with overseeing the development of its insurance business across Asia-Pacific. Deepak Soni, Chief Executive Officer of Optio Group, commented: “Asia-Pacific is a key market for us as we continue to build a broader specialty insurance platform. Circles Group provides an established regional platform from which to develop new capabilities and bring more of Optio’s underwriting expertise to clients and partners across Asia-Pacific.

item.title: US E&S direct premium growth slows sharply in 2026 as market softens: ALIRT
item.description: ALIRT Insurance Research’s recent analysis has revealed that Excess & Surplus (E&S) lines direct premium growth slowed considerably in the first half of 2026, following years of record expansion as the insurance pricing cycle shifts. Surplus Lines Overview, which examines industry-wide trends and the financial performance of its 50 Company E&S Lines Composite, E&S direct premium growth moderated to an annualised 2.8% through H1 2026, in line with overall U.S. As admitted insurers increasingly reassess risks previously transferred to the E&S market, ALIRT anticipates further pressure on surplus lines premium growth.

item.title: Nordea Bank Risks Almost $1 Billion Fine in Denmark Money Laundering Case
item.description: Nordea Bank Abp is facing a potential 6.6 billion-krone ($988 million) penalty as a Danish court prepares to rule in a case over failures to prevent money laundering that go back more than a decade. The case marks the first time a money-laundering investigation against a bank has gone to court in Denmark, where previous incidences have been settled. Danske Bank settled a landmark case in late 2022, in which it admitted to all money laundering-related charges.

item.title: Aircraft Bomb Threats Persist in Europe, Causing More Diversions
item.description: Read more: European Airlines Face Second Wave of Aircraft Bomb Threats “To have this in a coordinated way, I don’t think we’ve seen this before,” Ben Smith, the CEO of Air France-KLM, said Thursday on a media call. Sporadic bomb threats continued to disrupt multiple flights across Europe on Friday, capping a week of unusual alerts that have put the aviation industry on guard and raised alarm with authorities. In France, there were four bomb threats on aircraft crossing the country’s airspace, the Prime Minister’s office said.

item.title: Archdiocese of NY Finalizes $800M Fund for Sex Abuse Survivors; Avoids Bankruptcy
item.description: The archdiocese and some parishes will provide a total compensation fund for victim survivors of $804.25 million. The Archdiocese of New York has finalized an $800 million settlement to resolve more than 1,300 outstanding claims of sexual abuse by clergy filed under the state’s Child Victim’s Act (CVA) and other laws. Hicks said the archdiocese’s goal has always been to bring a “fair and just resolution” for victim-survivors, and to “promote healing and reconciliation” among those who have been hurt.

item.title: Confie acquires the insurance operations of Texas Dow Employees Credit Union
item.description: Confie has acquired the insurance operations of Texas Dow Employees Credit Union, expanding its credit union insurance business into Texas. All 34 employees supporting TDECU’s insurance business will join InsureOne’s credit union division. “Credit unions are an important part of Confie’s growth strategy, and this partnership represents a significant expansion of that business into Texas,” said Cesar Soriano, CEO of Confie.

item.title: Sierra acquires browser automation company Anon
item.description: Anon’s team will join Sierra, bringing expertise in authentication, credential handling and browser automation. Sierra has acquired Anon , a company that builds technology allowing AI agents to sign in to websites, navigate pages and complete tasks when an API is unavailable. The technology will help Sierra’s agents complete work across websites and portals, including entering information and handling multi-factor authentication.

item.title: Chrysalis cuts wefox stake by a third, citing debt default risk
item.description: In its quarterly NAV announcement published November 2, 2026 , the UK-listed investor said the valuation is “determined on a fair value basis less a discount reflecting the risk of a default under the group’s debt facilities.” wefox “carries senior and mezzanine debt, which ranks ahead of the Company’s investment.” Chrysalis holds its stake as convertible loans and preferred equity. The valuation at 30 September 2026 is determined on a fair value basis less a discount reflecting the risk of a default under the group’s debt facilities. Chrysalis Investments has cut the carrying value of its wefox holding to £23.9 million as of September 30, 2026, from £36.0 million three months earlier.

item.title: Lemonade Completes Nationwide Renters Insurance Rollout
item.description: (Image source: IIR.) Lemonade (New York) has launched renters insurance in Minnesota, completing nationwide availability for the product across all 50 states and Washington, D.C. The expansion makes renters insurance the first Lemonade product offered throughout the United States. “From the start, we built Lemonade Renters to remove the complexity that makes traditional insurance frustrating, and to offer affordable coverage that renters can buy and manage on their own terms,” comments Dan Timsit, Head of Renters Insurance, Lemonade.

item.title: Google AI in School Triggered Teen’s Mental Health Crisis, Lawsuit Says
item.description: It scored significantly worse on safety than the previous generation of Google’s AI, responding appropriately to messages about mental health just 7% of the time, according to findings from the nonprofit research initiative KORA cited in the complaint. Parents in North Carolina sued Google after their 13-year-old daughter spent months discussing suicidal thoughts with the company’s artificial intelligence tools on her school-issued Chromebook, underscoring the potential risks of the technology as parents and educators debate AI’s place in schools. By the time the school notified her parents, she had been corresponding with Google about such topics for months, often using a feature in Google Search known as AI Mode.

item.title: Smiling Regularly May Be Good for Your Health
item.description: “It’s just like another thing that you can add to your toolbox.” Smiling can affect one’s level of cortisol, a hormone the body releases partly to help regulate stress and mood, according to Ho. Research backs up the fact that smiling goes a long way. “When you’re doing it in a room by yourself, you’re not doing it in a social interaction, maybe it’s making you remember, or it’s an effect of remembering some good thing that happened and that would put you in a better mood.” At the Orange County Academy of Sciences and Arts in Southern California, the power of a smile is taken very seriously.
